description: Intent i008 (vm-shared-desc-rereads, snapshot s02) complete. REPORTED FINDING: drivers/net/virtio_net.c:1018-1031, receive_buf(): hdr = skb_vnet_hdr(skb) points into the guest/device-writable receive buffer holding the virtio_net_hdr. The function fetches hdr->hdr.flags at line 1021 to decide skb->ip_summed = CHECKSUM_UNNECESSARY, then passes &hdr->hdr to virtio_net_hdr_to_skb() (include/linux/virtio_net.h:26-74) which independently re-fetches hdr->flags, gso_type, gso_size, csum_start, csum_offset from the same shared memory with no READ_ONCE/local snapshot. The validated copies (skb_partial_csum_set at net/core/skbuff.c:4396 validates csum_start/csum_offset against headroom/headlen) and the consumed copies (skb->ip_summed, csum_start/csum_offset, shinfo gso_type/gso_size) can diverge under a racing device/guest writer — the same validate-then-use TOCTOU mechanism as the AF_XDP seed, on the virtio shared packet header instead of UMEM metadata. Confidence medium: mechanism verbatim present; OOB exploitability is bounded because skb_partial_csum_set revalidates the csum pair, so the unvalidated divergence is the line-1021 flags decision vs fields validated inside virtio_net_hdr_to_skb, and gso consistency. Negative evidence from the same bounded search: vhost core is clean — vhost_get_vq_desc (vhost.c:2071) and get_indirect (vhost.c:1886) snapshot each guest descriptor into a local struct vring_desc via vhost_copy_from_user/copy_from_iter_full and use only the local copy (next_desc READ_ONCEs the local); __vringh_iov (vringh.c:255) same pattern; virtqueue_get_buf_ctx (virtio_ring.c:698) reads used-ring id once into a local and range-checks before detach_buf; avail head fetched once and bounds-checked; vhost_net_build_xdp and vhost_vsock_alloc_pkt copy headers into local buffers before validation/use. One unresolved minor: receive_mergeable() re-reads hdr->num_buffers only inside a post-loop pr_debug (benign). Limitations: vhost/scsi.c, vhost/test.c internals, virtio_ccw config space, vop_vringh.c, caif_virtio.c, and most virtio function drivers were only spot-checked; no dynamic testing performed. Final artifact written to agent-state/findings/i008.json with snapshots_checked ["s02"] and execution_status complete.
